# agent-surface-scan
**Scan the AI-agent attack surface of a repository.** A single-binary, dependency-free static scanne
r that finds prompt-injection vectors, remote-execution instructions, exfiltration prompts, approval
-bypass language, hidden characters, deceptive links, hardcoded live secrets and dangerous MCP confi
gurations — in the files coding agents actually read: `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.cursorrules`, `REA
DME`, issue templates, skills, MCP configs and docs.
> 中文简介：一个零依赖单二进制扫描器，专门检查「AI 编码代理会读到的仓库文本」里的提示注入、远程执行、数据外泄、绕过审批、隐藏字符、欺骗性链接、硬编码密钥与危险 MCP 配置。输出文本 / Mar
kdown / JSON / SARIF，可做 CI 门禁，17 条规则全部映射 OWASP Agentic Security Initiative（ASI）分类。
## Why
Coding agents trust repository text as instructions. Attackers have moved from attacking the code to
attacking the context: poisoned READMEs that make the agent run remote code and bypass human approv
al. `agent-surface-scan` is a CI gate for that context — static, fast, and opinionated about what ag
ent-facing text must never do.
## Features
- **17 rules** mapped to the OWASP Agentic Security Initiative (ASI) taxonomy, with severity tiers (

bare `sudo` = low, real escalation = high)
- Discovers 6 classes of agent-facing files (instructions

, README, contributing/security docs, issue/PR templates, skills, MCP configs, docs)
- Four output f

ormats: **text, Markdown, JSON, SARIF 2.1.0** (upload straight to GitHub Code Scanning)
- `--fail-on

` CI gate with exit codes; `--exclude` path patterns; `.surface-scanignore` allowlist
- Rule selecti

on: `--rules`, `--skip-rules`, `--min-severity` for noisy repositories
- Single-file scanning (`surf

ace-scan scan README.md`) plus directory scanning
- Inline suppression markers (`surface-scan:ignore

`, `surface-scan:ignore-file`)
- **Claude Code and Codex hooks** — block the agent from reading flag

ged files
- **DSH plugin** (`agentscan-dsh`) — the `surface_scan` tool + `agentscan` skill inside De

epSeek Harness
- **Benchmark cases** modeled on real-world incidents, enforced in CI
- **False-posit
ive report** on real repositories: 0 high/critical findings on gin, express, flask, axios and fastap

i
- Pure Go standard library — no runtime dependencies; builds to one binary

### Suppression
Two markers, both written as ordinary comments:
| Marker | Effect |

| `# surface-scan:ignore` | suppresses findings on that line (any comment style: `#`, `//`, ``) |
|
`# surface-scan:ignore-file` | suppresses all findings in the file |
Use them for intentional, reviewed exceptions (for example a documented example command in your own
README) — and require a comment explaining why.

## Security & scope
This tool is **defensive**: it audits your own repositories and is intended for use inside CI and on
authorized code only. The bundled corpus contains only synthetic, minimal samples for detection tes
ts — not weaponized payloads. See SECURITY.md.
